description: This file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android app. It displays a search box and a grid of products. Users can tap a product to view details. It includes an inner adapter class for the product grid.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment that displays a search input and a grid of products, handling user interactions to filter products and navigate to product details.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes views, sets up product data, and attaches event listeners.

classes.name: ProductGridAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for binding product data to grid view items, with an update method to refresh data.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Updates the adapter's dataset and refreshes the grid view.
